no v104 pipeline or sprint gates

validation_sequence.stage: After callback version and initial actionable status integration; before later narrow status and provenance additions
After no host prefilled accept and post-delivery rejection status correction
After equal-bytes and pre-integration-test negative controls
Final source; adds a real published-patch unscheduled merge rejection and unchanged identity assertion

test_execution: The fixture invokes real pytest in small synthetic temporary source trees as an ordinary user; public callback binds actor, group, request and source hashes. It is not SWE-bench grading.
validation_reporting: Incremental necessary checks are reported separately. The full 10-test suite is not claimed to have been rerun on the final source hashes. Final logical_time/work_stage identity metadata additions are also exercised by the separate SDK integration control owned by runtime agent when that control completes.
known_boundaries: Small synthetic repository only; large-repository memory safety is not established here.
No actual agent coordination quality or task success improvement has been measured.
A public test execution can fail; explicit accept records its true outcome and never equates it with official correctness.
REVIEW2 delivery gate is an intentional condition difference; basic modification permissions remain equal.
Observation received/use attribution requires the runtime observer and actual model-input evidence; world availability is not actual receipt.

runtime_interfaces.public_records: role/review records carry event_sequence and logical_time; review identity has exact patch source/ref and file/metadata hashes
